{{Disclaimer|The Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 both lack a universal achievement system. On those platforms, <i>Hollow Knight: Silksong</i> includes the achievements as in-game "Feats".}}

{{Hr|SS}}

<h1>Achievements (PC/Xbox/Nintendo)</h1>
=== Tools ===
There are a total of 51 Tools to be found in the game. Refer to the [[Tools]] page for a list of locations.

{{Achievements|allgames=silksong|Equipped|Arsenal}}

=== Silk Skills ===
There are a total of 6 skills to be found in the game. Refer to the [[Skills and Abilities (Silksong)|Silk Skills]] page for a list of locations.

{{Achievements|allgames=silksong|Bound|Woven}}

=== Mask Shards ===
There are a total of 20 shards to be found in the game. Refer to the [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Mask Shard]] page for a list of locations.

{{Achievements|allgames=silksong|Protected|Masked}}

=== Spool Fragments ===
There are a total of 18 fragments to be found in the game. Refer to the [[Spool Fragment]]s page for list of locations.

{{Achievements|allgames=silksong|Restored|Extended}}

=== Crests ===
There are a total of 7 crests to be found in the game. Refer to the [[Crests]] page for list of locations.

{{Achievements|allgames=silksong|Claimed|Consumed}}

=== Silk Hearts ===
There are a total of 3 hearts to be found in the game. Refer to the [[Silk Heart]]s page for list of locations.

{{Achievements|allgames=silksong|Regenerated}}

=== Bosses ===
{{Achievements|allgames=silksong|Liberated|Pharloom's Welcome|Servant|Fanatic|Judge|Last Dance|Tragedian|White Knight|Grey Ghost|Heretic|Tyrant|Seed|Diva|Lamenter|Hero's Call|Fatal Resolve}}

=== Fleas ===
There are a total of 30 Fleas to be found in the game. Refer to the [[Fleas]] page for a list of locations.

{{Achievements|allgames=silksong|Flea Finder|Fleafriend}}

=== Bellways & Ventrica Stations ===
There are a total of 10 Bellways and 6 Ventrica Stations in the game. Refer to the [[Bellway]]s page and [[Ventrica Station]]s page for a list of locations and toll prices.

{{Achievements|allgames=silksong|Connected|Transported}}

=== Miscellaneous ===
The following Achievements are related to NPCs and their quests. Please see their individual pages for more information.

{{Achievements|allgames=silksong|Bonded|Cartographer|Granted|Glutton|Trail's End|Entwined|Resident|Harmonious|Remembrance}}

=== Challenges ===
{{Achievements|allgames=silksong|Keen Hunter|True Hunter|Completion|Speed Completion|Speedrunner|Steel Soul|Steel Heart}}

=== Endings ===
There are five endings to <i>Hollow Knight: Silksong</i>. For more information, please see [[Endings (Silksong)|Endings]].

{{Achievements|allgames=silksong|Weaver Queen|Snared Silk|Twisted Child|Sister of the Void|Passing of the Age}}
